In this video we cover:
Asian Paints Losing Ground to Birla Opus?
Asian Paints is under pressure. In just 12 months, its market share dropped from 59% to 52%, losing 7% to new entrant Birla Opus. Backed by aggressive pricing and rapid distribution, Birla Opus has shaken up the ₹70,000 crore Indian paint industry. Despite a legacy of innovation and dominance, Asian Paints is now facing declining profits, weak demand, and intense competition. This video explores Asian Paints’ journey, its current struggles, and how Birla’s entry is changing the game.
